conclusion: The O04, O06xO08 and O07 full-orbit review reports, the O03 current native fire-bound report, and the 400-frame O06xO08 artifact correctness audit carry the current audited release hash. The current-release O05 invalidation rerun closes discrete cache freshness, and the current-release O05 sustained size study uses the same audited release binary and closes the offscreen sustained-timing gate on M1 Max/Metal. Only the 16-cubed screen-filling condition shows a repeatable GPU-render reduction; whole-frame work is effectively flat, so keep direct sampling default and caching opt-in. The 4247485106ee2d30... fixed-tick report group remains untraceable and is not present among current binaries; the O08 RG16 fallback report predates renderer/session/window source changes. Keep those historical records as exact-build evidence, not current-release proof. Recheck remaining untraceable O03/O04/O06xO08 fixed-tick claims as needed; O08 RG16 fallback still needs a current-release rerun. Windows/DX12, other adapters and native-window platform gates remain open.
